summary: Iteration 2 E2E: 31/31 backend pytest (21 regression + 10 new iteration-2). All 3 new features validated end-to-end: (1) Razorpay checkout — /credits/topup returns real order_id starting with 'order_', amount=49900 paise, key_id=rzp_test_*, INR; invalid pack→400; /credits/verify with bad signature→400 'Invalid Razorpay signature'; payment_transactions row inserted with status='created'. Frontend: window.Razorpay loaded, clicking topup-starter fires API call (200) and opens the Razorpay iframe. (2) Zone editor — POST /cameras accepts zones; PATCH /cameras/{id} persists normalized 0-1 polygon points; GET reflects them; analyze runs zone-aware and returns a valid event. UI ZoneEditor opens, canvas click adds points, Close polygon adds zone, Save persists → 'Zones saved' toast → camera card shows zone badge. (3) Twilio BYO WhatsApp — POST /settings/byo saves nested twilio {sid,token,from}; GET returns masked partials; whatsapp channel with fake BYO creds returns status='error' with twilio auth detail (proves REAL API call, not simulated); channel WITHOUT BYO returns status='error' detail='No twilio keys in Settings'. Slack/webhook still 'sent', email/teams still 'simulated'. Alerts modal: kind=whatsapp shows provider dropdown [twilio,plivo]; kind=sms shows [twilio,plivo,exotel,vonage,messagebird]; kind=slack has no dropdown. Settings shows 'CONFIGURED · 3' badge for Twilio after save.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1067 lines — becoming hard to maintain. Recommend splitting into routers/: auth.py, cameras.py, detections.py, analyze.py, channels.py, credits.py, byo.py.

In dispatch_alert() the whatsapp/sms/voice branch returns early on 'missing to number' or 'no <provider> keys' BEFORE inserting an alert_deliveries record (lines 364, 369). This means error dispatches aren't logged in the deliveries collection. Consider inserting a record for these early-return errors for auditability.
topup uses body.pack; TopupIn also has origin_url but it's unused. Either wire it (into Razorpay callback_url) or drop it.

credit_tx grants credits BEFORE Razorpay verification is done via verify (which uses find_one({status not paid}) idempotency guard — OK); however if Razorpay webhook fires AND user manually calls verify, both attempt to add credits (webhook uses status!='paid' filter, verify uses status='paid' short-circuit) — collision window is tight but exists if run concurrently. Consider a Mongo unique index or atomic $set with status transition.
verify_payment does not validate that the razorpay_order_id belongs to the current user (the find_one is scoped to user_id, so 404s cleanly — OK); good.
Razorpay signature verification uses hmac.compare_digest — good. RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET is loaded from .env — good.
BYO masking in get_byo may return an empty string '' for empty fields but frontend fills that as placeholder — cosmetic only.
Zone points are normalized 0-1 and stored as-is — server does not clamp/validate range. Consider server-side clamp to [0,1] and enforce min 3 points.
